description: Internal cryptographic functions for elliptic curve hashing and scalar conversion in BoringSSL, including hash-to-curve and hash-to-scalar functions for P256 and P384 curves.

methods.name: ec_hash_to_curve_p256_xmd_sha256_sswu
methods.description: Hashes a message to a point on the P256 elliptic curve using the XMD:SHA-256_SSWU suite.

methods.name: ec_hash_to_curve_p384_xmd_sha384_sswu
methods.description: Hashes a message to a point on the P384 elliptic curve using the XMD:SHA-384_SSWU suite.

methods.name: ec_hash_to_scalar_p384_xmd_sha384
methods.description: Hashes a message to a scalar value on the P384 curve, producing a value modulo the group order.

methods.name: ec_hash_to_curve_p384_xmd_sha512_sswu_draft07
methods.description: Hashes a message to a point on the P384 curve using the draft-irtf-cfrg-hash-to-curve-07 suite.

methods.name: ec_hash_to_scalar_p384_xmd_sha512_draft07
methods.description: Hashes a message to a scalar on the P384 curve using the draft-irtf-cfrg-hash-to-curve-07 suite.
